subject: Evaluation playbook & gating checklist for Zelig Payments - sprint checkpoint
messages:
From: Ari Cohen <ari@zeligpay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zeligpay.com, security@zeligpay.com
Date: 2027-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Zelig MAP kickoff: gating checklist + evidence cadence

Marcus / Irene —

Thanks for the intro call earlier. We loved the demo and want to align on the MAP and the security gates we'll need to hit before our procurement team signs the contract. High level asks from our side: SOC 2 attestation, SIG/CAIQ responses, executed DPA with EU data residency language, and a short data retention table for transactional logs and backups.

Can you confirm:
- What SOC 2 evidence artifacts you can provide during evaluation (reports vs. snapshot vs. in-scope control evidence) and an expected delivery date for a redacted snapshot?
- Whether the SIG/CAIQ doc can be completed within two weeks of MAP start?
- Proposed deadlines we should include in the MAP to aim for a 2027-12-15 signature target.

We're proposing a two-week sprint to lock evidence owners and an internal security review the week after. Procurement is copying in the cost/legal contacts.

Appreciate a concise checklist and ideal dates so we can map internally.

Thanks,
Ari Cohen
Head of Integrations, Zelig Payments
Ari: +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Attachments: none in this initial note

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ari Cohen <ari@zeligpay.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, procurement@zeligpay.com
Date: 2027-11-02T11:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Zelig MAP kickoff: gating checklist + evidence cadence

Ari —

Thanks for the clear list. We can be concise on each ask — below is a proposed acceptance checklist + target delivery windows that fit your 2027-12-15 signing target. I attached a draft MAP workbook with the milestone lane and owners.

Proposed acceptance checklist (short):
- SOC 2: provide redacted SOC 2 Type II report + control evidence snapshot for access control, change management, and incident response. Target: redacted snapshot by 2027-11-10; full attestation link by 2027-11-20.
- SIG/CAIQ: complete vendor responses and technical annex. Target: draft to you by 2027-11-12; final by 2027-11-18.
- DPA: We can share a standard DPA with EU data residency and subprocessors appendix. Legal will accept reasonable redlines; propose initial DPA sent 2027-11-03, redline turnaround target 5 business days.
- Data retention: attached table in the MAP workbook — transactional logs 90 days by default, backups retained 180 days; we can discuss tiering and escrow for EU residency.

Sprint plan (2-week):
Week 1 (11/1–11/7): owners assigned, SIG draft, SOC2 snapshot extraction, DPA initial share.
Week 2 (11/8–11/14): evidence intake, internal control Q&A, finalize SIG/CAIQ, legal redline cycle.
Week 3 buffer (11/15–11/21): remediation items, final evidence upload, SOW/Docusign prep.

If that aligns, we'll mark Neha (legal/ops) as the DPA owner and Irene to lead SIG/CISO questions. I've attached: Zelig_MAP_Draft.xlsx (MAP workbook) and redacted-soc2-snapshot.pdf (redacted control evidence).

Next steps: Ari — can you confirm procurement's acceptance of this schedule? Also, who on your team will be the SIG point-person so we can route clarifying questions?

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0128

Attachments: Zelig_MAP_Draft.xlsx (MAP workbook with milestones and owners); redacted-soc2-snapshot.pdf (redacted controls snapshot)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Ari Cohen <ari@zeligpay.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, procurement@zeligpay.com
Date: 2027-11-05T14:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Zelig MAP kickoff: gating checklist + evidence cadence

Ari / Marcus —

Thanks — I reviewed the MAP workbook and SOC snapshot. A few technical clarifications and commitments from our side so you can route to your engineers/CISO: 

1) SIG/CAIQ scope: we'll complete the standard CAIQ plus an addendum for our private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) if you plan to evaluate Private. Please confirm whether you'll consider Private in the evaluation — that affects some answers around network controls and key management.

2) SOC 2 evidence: the snapshot includes redacted logs for access control and a sample change-management ticket. We cannot share production PII in attachments; we can provide redacted exports and a timeboxed access window to the control evidence repository for your security review team. Proposed window: 11/15–11/17 (2 business days).

3) DPA specifics: Neha will lead the redline review. From a technical perspective, the main asks we expect from EU customers are: data residency options (region scoping), subprocessors list, and an agreed retention matrix. We'll include a draft retention table in the MAP workbook; if Zelig needs custom retention tiers for EU customers, we'll capture that as a contract annex.

4) Escalation path: in case of open control questions past 11/18, propose a final 1-hour sync with our CISO desk (Irene + security engineering) during week of 11/22 to unblock contract signature.

Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Security PM, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Marcus / Irene —

This all looks good and aligns with our internal expectations. Procurement confirms acceptance of the sprint and the 12/15 signature goal. A few clarifying notes from our side:

- SIG lead: that's me for now; I'll loop in our application security lead (security@zeligpay.com) when we hit the SIG Qs.
- SOC 2 window: 11/15–11/17 works; we'll schedule two reviewers.
- DPA redlines: procurement requests the initial DPA be sent to procurement@zeligpay.com (copy legal@zeligpay.com) and we aim to return redlines by 11/10 (we may need a short extension if internal procurement has follow-ups).
- Data residency: we can accept the default retention table for the contract but ask for an explicit EU residency clause for EU customers as an annex.

Could you please:
1) Upload the final MAP workbook (with owners and dates) to the Drive link and invite procurement@zeligpay.com.
2) Confirm the SOC2 evidence access window and the contact for the one-hour CISO sync (Irene — is that you?).

I'll get procurement and security on the calendar after the MAP workbook is shared. Looking forward to the sprint.

Best,
Ari
Head of Integrations, Zelig Payments
